metadata.scope: Reanalysis of an archived historical import log; no raw REDD ingestion or original Python 2 execution.
metadata.timestamp_timezone: UTC; Unix source timestamps preserved without a local-time assumption.
metadata.fraction_scale: All fraction/density fields are on 0..1 scale; multiply by 100 for percent.
metadata.power_units: Source integer power numerals. Export names say VA, but this analysis does not establish channel measurands, calibration, or physical accuracy.
metadata.quantile_definition: Linear interpolation of sorted values at (n-1)*p; Hyndman-Fan type 7.
metadata.source_version_limit: Archived export paths contain 3sec while the pinned script uses lowf; source/log execution identity is not established.
limits: Grid-row density is not continuous-time uptime, a raw sensor-missingness rate, or a corruption rate.
Incomplete rows mix cadence, timestamp-coincidence, boundaries, and unavailable grouped fields; causes cannot be separated from this log.
Row-level altered counts include heuristic lead/lag substitutions and fallback rebuilds; only fallback rebuild magnitudes are logged in detail.
Fallback magnitudes describe a selected subset of negative-residual rows, not the distribution of all mismatches or all repairs.
Do not integrate sparse retained/rebuild rows as if they were contiguous one-second energy observations.
No estimate of raw gap lengths, changed energy, model accuracy, or causal score effect is supported by these log-only statistics.

data_dictionary.grid_rows: Inclusive integer-second positions from channel-1 first timestamp to last timestamp, as reported in the archived log.
data_dictionary.grid_span_days: grid_rows/86400; calendar-grid span, not observed recording uptime.
data_dictionary.grid_span_house_days: Sum of six per-house grid spans/86400; household exposure denominator, not one wall-clock interval.
data_dictionary.observed_mains_channel1_rows: Archived source actual len for mains channel 1; not both mains legs verified individually.
data_dictionary.observed_mains_row_density_of_grid: Observed channel-1 rows/grid_rows; describes source timestamp density.
data_dictionary.no_timestamp_grid_rows: Rows skipped by historical no-timestamp counter; grid_rows minus observed channel-1 rows reconciles exactly.
data_dictionary.incomplete_grouped_rows: Rows with a mains timestamp skipped for a sentinel after grouping; not a certified count of failed individual sensors.
data_dictionary.exported_rows: Retained historical rows, including reported substitutions/rebuilds.
data_dictionary.lead_substitutions: Historical timestamp-lead counter; heuristic successful future-mains replacements, not independent clock-error measurements.
data_dictionary.lag_substitutions: Historical timestamp-lag counter; heuristic successful past-mains replacements, not independent clock-error measurements.
data_dictionary.fallback_rebuilds: Historical negative-noise counter; count of paired ERROR: neg noise / NEW records.
data_dictionary.main_before: MAIN value immediately before a logged fallback rebuild, already processed/quantized by the historical importer.
data_dictionary.main_after: MAIN value in its paired NEW vector.
data_dictionary.main_delta: main_after-main_before; not a metrological error estimate or integrated energy.
data_dictionary.abs_main_delta: Absolute logged MAIN change; all parsed fallback changes happen to be positive.
data_dictionary.grouped_submeter_sum: Sum of grouped submeter numerals excluding timestamp, MAIN, and residual; validated against each log's sum field.
data_dictionary.new_residual: main_after-grouped_submeter_sum, also validated against printed new noise.
